question: In the Contra Costa County Employees' Retirement Association (CCCERA) April 2018 master custodian RFP, how many copies of the proposal must be submitted, and for how long must the proposal remain a firm and irrevocable offer?
gold_answer: One (1) original proposal, four (4) hard copies and one (1) copy in electronic form; the proposal must be a firm and irrevocable offer good for one year from the proposal due date (due 5:00 p.m. PT, Friday, May 25, 2018).
acceptance: Accept five paper sets total if the original is clearly included, plus one electronic copy; validity one year from due date. Actual proposal deadline is optional.
candidate_answer: CCCERA required **one original proposal, four hard copies, and one electronic copy**. The proposal had to remain a **firm and irrevocable offer for one year from the May 25, 2018 proposal due date**. [CCCERA Master Custodian RFP, pp. 18, 20](CCCERA__2018_cccera_master_custodian_rfp_april_2018.pdf)
